title: Job Workspace + Cross-Module Navigation Consistency
businessRequirement: Improve job workspace discoverability and cross-module navigation without creating a second job model, duplicating data, or changing any approved CR-008 workflows.
objectives: Add an explicit Jobs register/navigation surface using the existing Booking/Job records only.
Add Carrier Payment / Payer Control to the JobContextRail Related Tasks list and Quick View.
Add Open Job and Quick View actions to the NVOCC Booking Register.
Reuse the existing /bookings/{id} Job Workspace and current JobContextRail/Quick View architecture.
Preserve all approved CR-008 runtime behavior, roles, privacy, data model, workflows, notifications and communication functions.
outOfScope: No new Job database table or duplicate job entity.
No changes to job reference generation.
No changes to NVOCC/Forwarding business logic.
No changes to finance, payment, document-release, SLA, notification or external communication semantics.

web.impact: Add explicit Jobs navigation/menu entry for internal operational roles while preserving existing grouped sidebar and menu search.
New Jobs register presentation only, backed by the existing /bookings API and existing booking/job model.
Add Carrier Payment / Payer Control as a related task and Quick View target for applicable Forwarding jobs.
Add Open Job and Quick View actions per NVOCC booking row, linking to the existing /bookings/{id} workspace.
No workflow change expected; reused as the canonical Job Workspace target.

api.impact: No new business API required unless a presentation-only query optimization is proven necessary; existing /bookings scope remains source of truth.

shared: Existing role/privacy boundaries must remain unchanged.
Existing 5-digit booking/job reference must remain canonical.
NVOCC and Forwarding continue to share one Booking/Job model.
Customer/agent external users must not gain new internal job-register access.

jobsRegister.navigationRule: Open Job routes to /bookings/{id}; Quick View reuses existing embedded Job Workspace/JobContextRail pattern.

jobContextRail.visibilityRule: Show only where the existing role and business-model permissions already allow Carrier Payment access.

nvoccRegister.dataRule: No new data source; row id from existing NVOCC booking list.

acceptanceCriteria: CR-008 frozen runtime behavior is preserved except for the explicitly approved navigation additions.
A Jobs menu item is visible to approved internal roles and participates in menu search.
/jobs lists the same underlying Booking/Job records; counts and job refs match /bookings.
No second job table/entity or duplicated transactional state is introduced.
Opening a job from /jobs routes to the existing /bookings/{id} Job Workspace.
Quick View from /jobs opens the existing Job Workspace in embedded mode without losing context.
Carrier Payment / Payer appears in the right-side JobContextRail for applicable Forwarding jobs and opens via Quick View.
Carrier Payment / Payer remains unavailable where existing permissions/business-model rules deny it.
NVOCC Booking Register rows provide Open Job and Quick View actions into the existing Job Workspace.
Customer, Shipper, Consignee and unauthorized Agent users cannot access the internal Jobs register.
NVOCC and Global Forwarding portal access and privacy remain unchanged.
Jobs 50001–50005 remain fully navigable and transactionally unchanged.
No regression in documents, finance, payment, release, Operations Control, Action Queue, SLA, notifications or external communications.
Desktop/tablet/mobile layouts remain free of new horizontal-overflow regressions.

tests: Web build and frozen sidebar/menu regression.
Role-by-role UI access: GLOBAL_ADMIN, CONTROL_TOWER, BRANCH_OPS, FINANCE, AGENT, CUSTOMER, SHIPPER, CONSIGNEE.
Menu search finds Jobs and preserves all current CR-008 menu groups.
Jobs register parity check against /bookings for jobs 50001–50005.
Jobs register Open Job and Quick View navigation for 50001–50005.
JobContextRail Carrier Payment Quick View on Forwarding jobs.
Negative test: NVOCC and unauthorized roles do not gain Carrier Payment capability.
NVOCC register Open Job and Quick View actions.
Responsive desktop/tablet/mobile navigation and Quick View regression.
regressionPlan.reason: Requested change is presentation/navigation-only; full 50001–50005 mutation UAT is not required unless implementation touches shared runtime/business logic beyond the approved navigation scope.

approvalRequired: Explicit user approval of CR-20260924-009 is required before any implementation, build, merge to main, staging deployment or runtime change.
notes: DEFINE IMPACT + REGRESSION PLAN ONLY. No implementation is authorized by this CR definition.
